# Marimo Studio 0.2.3

Marimo Studio 0.2.3 improves view authoring, preview delivery, and agent workflows across Python, Browser, and Prepared runtimes.

## Author and manage views

- Rename views from the CLI, Python API, and Studio workspace while keeping the selected view and its published artifact connected.
- Use the view catalog commands to inspect, create, rename, and remove views with consistent diagnostics.
- `View.remove()` returns `ViewCatalog`, and the CLI catalog commands report the committed catalog record. Update integrations that consumed `ViewRemovalResult` to read `default_view`, `views`, and `catalog_generation` from `ViewCatalog`.
- Start a notebook with a default view when the workspace has no explicit selection.
- Keep the current and previous artifact revisions available while a new build is prepared.

## Inspect previews and sources

- Preview pages keep native notebook cells, controls, rich outputs, and projection state synchronized across view switches and reconnects.
- Local source files, view scripts, and provider projects report actionable errors when a script or source pattern cannot be loaded.
- Agent workflows can discover the active workspace, target a named view, and use the same source and publication records as the Studio UI.

## Provider and documentation updates

- Custom frontend providers have a guide covering project layout, build inputs, source inspection, and runtime selection.
- The Marimo Hub guide shows how to add views, run notebooks as apps, and open a Studio workspace.
- CLI help and reference pages use the same view and runtime names as the Studio interface.

## Compatibility

Marimo Studio 0.2.3 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and
[Marimo](https://marimo.io/) 0.25.0. The `deno` extra provides
[Deno](https://docs.deno.com/) 2.9.5 or newer for [React](https://react.dev/),
[Reveal.js](https://revealjs.com/), [Svelte](https://svelte.dev/), and
[Observable Notebook Kit](https://observablehq.com/notebook-kit/kit) authoring.
The `lens` extra requires
[marimo-lens](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-lens) 0.2.3 or newer.
